trials.execution: Configured fresh-process source diagnostics passed 12 tests: 11 cases and 11 unchanged comparisons retained 22 content-addressed records containing 33 single-revision executions and 1,392 probe executions. All 24 frozen files were unchanged. The full selected inventory retains two original Babel diagnostics and remains incomplete. These local observations report isolated:false; clean committed-suite receipts, full-corpus reexecution and production acceptance are not claimed by this focused run.

flagInputModel.scope: Every assignment of four selected Boolean INPUT values is authored for both conversion directions. This is not a gate/server domain or complete JavaScript input model.

trials.enumScope: Source enum has six literal numeric members1..6 and premium NONE0/PREMIUM1. Selected wrong types/unknown values characterize cast/fallback and Match errors; caller input domains remain unbounded.
trials.recordScope: Eight literal nonflag field tables,32 bounded generated Unicode records, nullish omission versus real defaults, truthy serializer flags versus strict numeric inverse flags and selected same-export error/retry pairs.
trials.compositionScope: Genuine returned raw records are retained and passed to the actual inverse; distinct fresh return identities are compared. No cache/reset/state API, arbitrary input retention, mutation or nested ownership proof is implied.
trials.gateScope: Full six-source AST recognizes zero gate descriptors but remains incomplete because the selected exact original Babel producer retains two dynamic-code-or-import diagnostics. No complete configuration cardinality is established.

sourceClosure.variants: Three primary modules have pinned alternate variants retained privately and explicitly unexecuted; only primary bodies are selected.
